name: WhatsApp
description: Link your own WhatsApp accounts to this workspace by scanning a QR code, then read and send messages from any agent. Several accounts at once — personal, work, a store line — each with its own pairing, its own chats and its own contacts.

skills.description: Read and send WhatsApp messages from a linked personal account (Baileys), across several accounts at once — account ids, JID shapes, the send throttle, and what to check when nothing is connected.

connector_port.description: Localhost port the WhatsApp connector service listens on. Change it only if something else on this workspace already uses it.

min_send_interval_ms.description: Minimum gap between two outbound messages on the SAME account. Sending faster than this is what gets a number banned — lower it at your own risk.

mark_read.description: Send read receipts (blue ticks) for messages an agent handles. Off by default: a blue tick tells the sender a human read their message.

auto_start.description: Start the connector automatically when the workspace boots.
